scope: Complete independent telling of the anonymous poem, all four fitts: beheading challenge, year-long promise, courtly/hunting exchange game, concealment, Green Chapel, and return.
editorial_boundary: Original English story and critical account of the anonymous received four-fitt Gawain poem, checked against Weston 1898 and academic manuscript records; no translated verse reproduced; interpretation not given as documentary historical fact.
